title: Organization and membership
text: Hosted machine codes exist before organization choice. The signed-in member's identity scopes organization selection, and its engine owns authorization after scoped service handoff. Repeating that route is idempotent; another organization requires a fresh connection. An authorized setup agent selects the intended organization and approves the matching request using that member's signed-in session. Team owns people, roles and email invites; Members retains seats and billing. Platform supplies authoritative inviter names; Platform users and engine actors are distinct identities. Source adoption is observed; changed Team consumer and production proof remain pending.
